name: plan-contract-an-unreadable-ledger-denies
description: An Edit whose ledger cannot be READ is refused: keel does not know what the file holds, and reading unknown text as empty would check nothing and allow everything. The unreadable ledger is staged as a DIRECTORY at the ledger path - the one shape every platform refuses to read as text, standing in for the Windows lock the reviewer named - so the fault is a real OSError that is not FileNotFoundError, which is the distinction the gate draws.

files.text: this file's PARENT is the ledger path, so the ledger is a directory

tool_input.old_string: Accept: the kernel suite is green.
